question: How should oblations be offered once the fire manifests with its five limbs?
premises: The activated knowledge becomes firmly established and blazes forth.
It becomes clear through five limbs beginning with knowing.
Oblations are to be made using those same five limbs.
inference: Once the fire is fully manifest in its fivefold form, each of those five limbs receives a single oblation.
uncertainties: The exact list of the five limbs beginning with jñatva is not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: When it is firmly established and blazes forth, clear with the five limbs beginning with knowing, one should offer an oblation once with each of those five limbs.
